import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Queue;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int v, x, cap;
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] l, cur, d;
        int tot, u, v, s, t, src, sink;

        public MaxFlow(int N) {
            l = new int[N];
            cur = new int[N];
            d = new int[N];
        }

        void add(int u, int v, int cap) {
            Edge e = new Edge();
            e.v = v;
            e.x = l[u];
            e.cap = cap;
            l[u] = tot++;
            Edge e2 = new Edge();
            e2.v = u;
            e2.x = l[v];
            e2.cap = 0;
            l[v] = tot++;
        }

        void init() {
            for (int i = 0; i < l.length; i++) {
                l[i] = -1;
            }
            tot = 0;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            for (int i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                d[i] = -1;
            }
            d[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            q.add(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int i = l[u]; i != -1; i = cur[u] = l[cur[u]]) {
                    int v = l[i] >> 1;
                    if (d[v] == -1 && ((Edge) l[i]).cap > 0) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[sink] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int in) {
            if (u == sink) {
                return in;
            }
            int flow = 0, f;
            for (int i = l[u]; i != -1; i = cur[u] = l[cur[u]]) {
                int v = l[i] >> 1;
                if (d[v] == d[u] + 1 && ((Edge) l[i]).cap > 0) {
                    if ((f = dfs(v, Math.min(in - flow, ((Edge) l[i]).cap))) > 0) {
                        flow += f;
                        ((Edge) l[i]).cap -= f;
                        ((Edge) l[i ^ 1]).cap += f;
                        if (flow == in) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow < in) {
                d[u] = -1;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        int dinic(int _src, int _sink) {
            src = _src;
            sink = _sink;
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                flow += dfs(src, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] field, capsule;
    static int[][] Z, S;
    static int[] dx = { -1, 1, 0, 0 };
    static int[] dy = { 0, 0, -1, 1 };

    static boolean in(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n;
    }

    static MaxFlow F = new MaxFlow(210);

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
        int src = n * n * 2;
        int sink = src + 1;
        F.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            line = br.readLine().split("");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                field[i][j] = line[j].charAt(0);
                if (field[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    x = i;
                    y = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            line = br.readLine().split("");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                capsule[i][j] = line[j].charAt(0);
                if (capsule[i][j] != 'Y' && Character.isDigit(capsule[i][j])) {
                    F.add(i * n + j + n * n, sink, capsule[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(x, y, Z);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(field[i][j])) {
                    F.add(src, i * n + j, field[i][j] - '0');
                    bfs(i, j, S, true);
                }
            }
        }
        pw.println(F.dinic(src, sink));
        pw.close();
    }

    static void bfs(int x, int y, int[][] d) {
        int sx = x;
        int sy = y;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                d[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            }
        }
        d[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(x);
        q.add(y);
        if (Character.isDigit(capsule[x][y])) {
            F.add(sx * n + sy, sx * n + sy + n * n, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x1 = q.poll();
            int y1 = q.poll();
            if (d[x1][y1] == t) {
                break;
            }
            for (int o = 0; o < 4; o++) {
                int xx = x1 + dx[o];
                int yy = y1 + dy[o];
                if (in(xx, yy) && d[xx][yy] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && capsule[xx][yy] != 'Y') {
                    if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x1][y1] + 1 || Z[xx][yy] == d[x1][y1] + 1 && Character.isDigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                        d[xx][yy] = d[x1][y1] + 1;
                        if (Character.isDigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                            F.add(sx * n + sy, xx * n + yy + n * n, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                        if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x1][y1] + 1 || !Character.isDigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                            q.add(xx);
                            q.add(yy);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
